title: Tempus AI's CEO Sold $6.6 Million in Stock the Day Before a Huge Rally. Here's What to Know
excerpt: This filing details a non-discretionary sale that reduced Lefkofsky's direct holdings by a small percentage.
content_html:
Jonathan Ponciano, The Motley Fool

Sat, August 22, 2026 at 7:03 AM EDT 4 min read

Eric P. Lefkofsky, the chairman and CEO of Tempus AI, Inc. (NASDAQ:TEM), disposed of about 133,000 shares of Class A Common Stock on August 18, according to an SEC Form 4 filing

Transaction summary

Transaction value based on SEC Form 4 weighted average sale price ($49.61); post-transaction value based on the August 18 market close ($49.36).

Key questions

  • What was the structural nature of this share disposition?
    The sale was non-discretionary, executed to cover tax obligations, and does not reflect the insider's view on the stock. This "sell to cover" mechanism is a standard arrangement used by the company to fund minimum statutory tax withholdings upon the vesting of equity awards.

  • What is the current scale of the CEO's equity exposure?
    Lefkofsky continues to control a small but meaningful percentage of the company through his direct and indirect holdings. The insider also holds derivative securities. As of the August 19 market close, the stock was priced at $61.25, following a one-year total return of -37%.

Company Overview

Company Snapshot

  • Tempus AI operates a comprehensive healthcare technology platform that integrates clinical diagnostic capabilities with advanced analytics and multimodal data repositories, generating revenue through its Tempus platform and Hub clinical application for next-generation sequencing testing.

  • The company operates a closed-loop, full-stack business model that establishes bi-directional integrations between clinician workflows and laboratory diagnostic services, enabling end-to-end solutions for healthcare providers and diagnostic testing.

  • The company serves physicians, healthcare providers, and clinical laboratories seeking advanced diagnostic capabilities and data-driven clinical decision support, with a primary focus on oncology and precision medicine applications.

Tempus AI is a healthcare technology company based in Chicago with a $10.7 billion market capitalization and approximately 3,800 employees. The company has achieved TTM revenue of $1.4 billion while investing heavily in research and development, reflected in a TTM net loss of $254.4 million. The company's competitive advantage stems from its integrated platform architecture, which combines diagnostic capabilities, advanced analytics, and proprietary multimodal data repositories to deliver differentiated clinical decision support solutions.
